rules.name: Hail to the King
rules.description: When Olaf uses the Command Action, Olaf and all friendly Draugr Faction models within 6" add [YELLOW] to their Melee Attacks for the remainder of the round (this bonus only applies once per round).

rules.name: First Among Reachmen
rules.description: If Red Eagle is the Party Champion, up to half the models in the Party may be Hirelings, replacing the usual restrictions. In addition, these Hirelings may include models with the Bandits Faction icon.

rules.name: Teleport Escape
rules.description: Once per game, Sigdis may move up to 10" as a Special Action. This does not count as normal movement and ignores intervening terrain and models. If Sigdis was Engaged, a Teleport Escape does not count as Withdrawing. This action may not be used to Engage an enemy.

rules.name: Flask and Phials
rules.description: Each time Curalmil uses a Potion, choose one friendly model within 3" and Line of Sight. That model immediately restores 1 point of either Health, Stamina, or Magicka. In addition, every time Curalmil assigns a Poison Token to an enemy, he may choose a different enemy within 3" of the first (if possible) and assign a Poison Token of the same type to that model.

rules.name: Protector
rules.description: At the start of the game, nominate one Objective, Special Objective, or Treasure Token in play. While she is within 3" of the nominated marker, the Gatekeeper adds [RED] to her Armor Rating. If the Gatekeeper removes an enemy as a casualty while she is within 3" of the marker, she gains one additional VP.
